description: Defines helper functions and factory methods for constructing dmrs_information objects used in 3GPP NR scheduling, specifically for PDSCH and PUSCH DMRS configurations, including calculations and default configurations.

methods.name: calculate_nof_dmrs_per_rb
methods.description: Calculates the number of resource elements used for DMRS per resource block in PDSCH and PUSCH.

methods.name: make_dmrs_info_common
methods.description: Creates a default dmrs_information object for DCI f1_0 or when higher layer parameters are unavailable, based on PDSCH or PUSCH configuration.

methods.name: make_dmrs_info_dedicated
methods.description: Creates a dedicated dmrs_information object for specific DMRS configurations, including uplink/downlink settings.
